explanation: Ono–Swaminathan (arXiv:2509.09553), Theorem 1, (1.2): the least positive admissible m with p((Dm²+1)/24) odd satisfies m_odd ≤ 12h(−D) + 2, where h(−D) is the class number of ℚ(√−D). The formal statement asserts some m coprime to 6 (hence positive) with m ≤ 12·classNumber(ℚ[X]/(X² + D)) + 2 and odd value; AdjoinRoot (X² + D) is ℚ(√−D). Faithful.
